title: Interaction affordances and a11y heuristics grooming
content:
High-level goal:
We want a prioritized set of small interaction and copy changes that improve discoverability and keyboard/AT experience across the Console. This doc captures heuristic findings from the March design review, quick wireframe scribbles for the most impactful screens, and a short backlog with recommended priorities and owners.

Summary of findings (quick):
- Primary action affordances are inconsistent across pages: some primary buttons use filled brand color, some are outline, and icon-only primary actions (table rows) lack accessible names. This causes confusion for keyboard and screen-reader users.
- Focus styles are missing or low-contrast on compact table controls and token chips at 1x density.
- Microcopy for error/help under inputs is incomplete; some fields rely solely on icons with no textual tooltip or aria-describedby.
- Live-updating regions (logs streaming, job progress) are not using aria-live or use polite incorrectly, leading to missed announcements or noisy updates.
- Modal dialogs sometimes trap focus incorrectly when multiple nested modals appear (e.g., config -> confirm delete).
- Keyboard keyboard-only users have awkward flows when dismissing toasts and opening inline editors (ESC handling inconsistent).
- Color token usage: button hover/focus states reuse token accent-600 which fails contrast on dark themes at 14px text sizes.

Wireframe notes (sketch descriptions):
1) Model Details header (compact):
   - Current: title, small actions (copy id, publish toggle) in a single row; actions are icon-only with tooltip on hover.
   - Proposed: keep icon-only, but add visually-hidden span with action name and an aria-label for the button. Add a subtle visible focus ring 3px using token focus-400.
   - Microcopy: tooltip: "Copy model ID" -> tooltip for screen readers: aria-describedby id on press that reads "Model ID copied to clipboard."

2) Route builder inline param editor:
   - Current: inline chips show param name and value, click opens small popover editor.
   - Issues: popover is not modal, focus sometimes remains outside; ESC closes page instead of popover; no aria-modal attr.
   - Proposed: make popover a focus trap with role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". Ensure initial focus is first input, ESC closes popover only. Add sr-only heading: "Edit parameter" and aria-describedby linking to help text explaining type/constraints.

3) Token/Cost table (high density):
   - Problem: many interactive cells (copy, details, graphs) only reveal controls on hover, inaccessible to keyboard-only users.
   - Proposed: always render controls in DOM order but visually hide with opacity for mouse-only flows; ensure tab sequence includes the cells. Provide skip-to-row anchor for jump-to-last-error in long tables.

Microcopy and status wording (recommended replacements):
- Old: "Request failed" -> New: "Request failed: 400 Bad Request — invalid prompt format." (include actionable hint or link to docs)
- Old: "Saved" toast -> New: "Pipeline saved. Changes will be active in < 2 min." (add estimated time)
- For long-running jobs: "Job running" -> "Indexing embeddings — 3 of 12 shards complete." (show progress when available)
- Confirm delete copy should name the entity: "Delete model "gpt-xx"? This action cannot be undone."

Accessibility specifics (priority bugs):
- A11y-1 (P0): Icon-only action buttons in tables and header must have accessible names (aria-label or aria-labelledby) and visible focus styles. Failure here prevents screen reader users from knowing action purpose.
  Suggested fix: add aria-labels and enforce focus outline token. Owner: Jordan. Est effort: 1 day (eng + design).
- A11y-2 (P1): Streaming log view should use aria-live=polite and should batch micro-updates to avoid flooding AT. Add a control to pause live updates and announce "updates paused" when toggled. Owner: Samir. Est: 2 days.
- A11y-3 (P1): Popover editors need role=dialog and focus management; nested confirmations should push focus to the top-level dialog. Owner: Elise. Est: 2-3 days.

Backlog grooming (short prioritized list):
1) P0 - Icon aria-label sweep (tables + topbar) — JIRA: UI-2045 — must ship this week.
2) P0 - Consistent focus tokens across components; add CSS variable --focus-outline to DS tokens and apply to Button, IconButton, Chip, TableRow — JIRA: DS-118.
3) P1 - Live-region improvements for logs and job shells; add pause control + batching — JIRA: LOG-77.
4) P1 - Modal/popover focus trap fixes + ESC behavior standardization — JIRA: UX-86.
5) P2 - Microcopy pass across toasts and error banners; create style guide examples for actionable errors — JIRA: UX-129.
6) P2 - Hover-only controls in dense tables (make accessible by keyboard) — JIRA: TABLE-40.

Implementation notes for devs (practical):
- Use the DS utility component <AccessibleIconButton label="Copy ID"> instead of raw <button>. Avoid relying solely on title attributes.
- For focus rings, don't use box-shadow only; combine outline + box-shadow for high contrast on both light and dark themes. Use tokens: focus-400 visible and focus-700 for strong contrast mode.
- For aria-live streams: implement a debounce/batch function that groups updates into 800ms windows; if >5 updates buffered, indicate "multiple updates" and provide a summary link to full log.
- Keyboard shortcuts: Add a small KBD legend area in Settings -> Keyboard Shortcuts that lists global shortcuts (e.g., "t" toggle terminal, "/" focus search). Ensure shortcuts can be disabled and are exposed in Preferences (accessibility setting).

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we want icon-only actions to remain default in dense headers, or should primary actions always show label on small widths? Tradeoff between density and discoverability. Proposal: show label by default on mobile and allow compact icon-only for desktop only after review.
- Toasts: auto-dismiss timing — 6s default but keep persistent if action required. Should we surface a preference? Recommendation: add opt-in preference to keep toasts until dismissed.
- RTL: we observed reversals in focus outline placement for some components during quick RTL smoke tests. Need dedicated QA pass for RTL and mirrored iconography.

Draft wireframe checklist for next meeting (assign and prepare):
- Jordan: produce 2 variants of Model Details header (label + icons vs icons-only) with keyboard walkthrough script.
- Samir: prototype aria-live batching for streaming logs (React hook + tiny demo page).
- Elise: compile list of 10 canonical popovers that fail focus management and propose unified focus utility.
- Priya: microcopy pass for top 20 toasts and inline errors; prepare suggested replacements.

Quick UX heuristics we used here (for reviewers):
- Affordance clarity: primary actions should have a persistent, perceivable affordance.
- Keyboard parity: any mouse-hover-only control must have keyboard equivalent that's discoverable via Tab and not hidden in CSS-only hover states.
- Assistive announcement hygiene: avoid flooding AT, provide summaries and pause controls.
- Contextual guidance: inline help must be concise and actionable, not just an error code.

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally prescriptive for the next sprint (small, high-impact changes). Please flag any items that are too large scope (we should split them out).
- For JIRA IDs above, these are placeholders until engineering creates the tickets.

Last edited notes: 2026-03-10 by Priya Nair — converted from whiteboard photos (mar-6) and March 3 design review audio notes.

Unresolved / parking-lot items:
- Full DS tokens audit to handle dark theme contrast across states (separate doc).
- Voiceover/JAWS spot checks across major screens (need SRE test environment).

End of doc.
